# Acme Cloud Services -- Data Processing Agreement

This fictional Data Processing Agreement between Halvard Systems and Acme Cloud Services covers managed cloud infrastructure and hosting services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

This Data Processing Agreement takes effect on 2026-07-20 and the current term expires on 2027-07-20. Renewal is automatic for a further twelve (12) month term unless either party gives sixty (60) days written notice that it does not wish to renew. Acme Cloud Services shall acknowledge a non-renewal notice in writing.

## Termination

Neither Halvard Systems nor Acme Cloud Services may terminate this Data Processing Agreement for convenience. Termination requires a material breach that remains uncured fifteen (15) days after written notice, or the insolvency of the other party.

## Limitation of Liability

The total liability of Acme Cloud Services under this Data Processing Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by Halvard Systems in the three (3) months before the claim arose, and neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss. This cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, to data protection breaches, or to unpaid fees, for which liability remains uncapped.

## Governing Law

Governing law and venue. The law of the Republic of Ireland applies to this Data Processing Agreement. Acme Cloud Services and Halvard Systems agree that the courts of the Republic of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes arising from it.

## Data Protection

Acme Cloud Services processes Customer Data only to deliver the services and only on documented instructions from Halvard Systems. The Data Protection Addendum attached to this Data Processing Agreement applies, and Acme Cloud Services shall notify Halvard Systems at least fifteen (15) days before engaging a new subprocessor.

## Confidentiality

Acme Cloud Services and Halvard Systems shall use Confidential Information only for the purposes of this Data Processing Agreement. The duty of confidence continues for two (2) years after the end of the term, and indefinitely for trade secrets.

## Notices

Contractual notices are delivered electronically: Halvard Systems receives notices at contracts@halvard.example.com and Acme Cloud Services at contracts@acmecloud.example.com. A notice is deemed received on the next business day after transmission.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Acme Cloud Services by Ines Calloway, Chief Revenue Officer. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
